newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa sells $85 mln 5-1/2 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa sells $85 mln 5-1/2 pct notes.

text.p: Mexican steel firm Ahmsa said Wednesday it had listed American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange and had sold $85 million of 5-1/2 percent senior discount convertible notes due Dec 15, 2001.

It said the notes were priced at $861.53 per $1,000 principal amount at maturity, with a yield to maturity of nine percent. It said the notes are convertible into ADS at a rate of 71.794 ADS per $1,000 of notes, or a conversion price of $12 per ADS at issuance, rising to $13.93 per ADS at maturity.
Each ADS represents five shares of Ahmsa common stock.
The notes have also been approved for listing on the NYSE.
The statement said Ahmsa would use proceeds from the issue to repay short-term debt.
Lead manager is Merrill Lynch and Co, with Inverlat International Inc as co-manager.
